SheetJS Community Edition vendored browser bundle

Version: 0.20.3 (verified from the bundle runtime)
Runtime path: /vendor/sheetjs/xlsx.full.min.js
Original source: https://cdn.sheetjs.com/xlsx-0.20.3/package/dist/xlsx.full.min.js
License: Apache-2.0; see LICENSE.txt.

The JavaScript bundle is preserved as distributed. It is loaded from this app's
own public assets, so spreadsheet exports do not require a third-party CDN at
runtime. To update it, replace the bundle and verify the version and workbook
round-trip before release.
